# Setup

Setups are scripted starting layouts in `setups/*.yaml`. A new table runs the setup named by the manifest's `setup` key; steps run in order, and anything they do not place is laid out in rows. See [Write a setup](../howto/write-a-setup.md) for a walkthrough and [Snapping](snapping.md) for how drop areas fill.

## Top-level keys

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"setup"` | yes | Marks this file as a setup. |
| `name` | text |  | Display name. Default: the file name. |
| `description` | text |  |  |
| `surfaces` | list of [SetupSurface](#setupsurface) |  | Surfaces besides the Centre, such as one per player, made before the steps run. Default: only the Centre. |
| `steps` | list of [SetupStep](#setupstep) | yes | Run in order on an empty table. |

## SetupSurface

A surface the table starts with besides the Centre, in tile order.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | text | yes | Surface id, used in `surface:` targets and steps' `surface`. Pattern: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`. |
| `name` | text |  | Name shown on its tile. Default: the id. |
| `seat` | true or false |  | Whether a player can sit here, such as a player area. |
| `color` | text |  | Colour of its tile frame and chip: a name from the assets file's colours, such as `red`, or a CSS colour such as `#c5523a`. |

## SetupStep

One setup instruction. The first key (`place`, `deal` or `shuffle`) decides the kind.

Type: [PlaceStep](#placestep) or [DealStep](#dealstep) or [ShuffleStep](#shufflestep)

## PlaceStep

Put components or a deck somewhere on the table.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `place` | text or object | yes | A component id from a library (places every one of them in the inventory), the id of one of them, the start of their ids up to a dot (`worker.red` places `worker.red.1`, `worker.red.2`, …), or `{ deck: <name> }`. |
| `at` | [Target](#target) | yes | Where something goes: an `[x, y]` position (on the Centre, or on the step's `surface`), a drop area as `component/area` or `component/area/index` (e.g. `main-board/market/2`), or `surface:<id>` for free room on a surface. |
| `face` | `"up"`, `"down"` |  | Turn face up or down. |
| `surface` | text |  | Surface an `[x, y]` position in `at` or `to` is on, from the setup's `surfaces`. Default: the Centre. Pattern: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`. |
| `rot` | number |  | Rotation in degrees. |
| `shuffle` | true or false |  | Shuffle a deck after placing it. |
| `lock` | true or false |  | Lock it in place, as a board usually is once it is where it belongs. |

## Target

Where something goes: an `[x, y]` position (on the Centre, or on the step's `surface`), a drop area as `component/area` or `component/area/index` (e.g. `main-board/market/2`), or `surface:<id>` for free room on a surface.

Type: [Vec2](#vec2) or text

## Vec2

An `[x, y]` pair in millimetres.

Type: [number, number]

## DealStep

Deal cards from the top of a deck.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deal` | object, see [`deal`](#dealstep-deal) | yes |  |

### DealStep deal

<a id="dealstep-deal"></a>

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | text | yes | Deck name. |
| `to` | [Target](#target) | yes | A snap target fills its spots in order; a position stacks the cards. |
| `count` | whole number > 0 | yes | Number of cards to deal. |
| `face` | `"up"`, `"down"` |  |  |
| `surface` | text |  | Surface an `[x, y]` position in `at` or `to` is on, from the setup's `surfaces`. Default: the Centre. Pattern: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`. |

## ShuffleStep

Shuffle a deck.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shuffle` | text | yes | Deck name. |

## Example

From `examples/harvest-moon/setups/2-player.yaml`:

```yaml
kind: setup
name: Two players
description: The board in the middle, five market cards face up and every worker ready below.
steps:
  - place: main-board
    at: [0, 0]
    lock: true
  - place: { deck: actions }
    at: [350, -130]
    shuffle: true
    face: down
  - deal: { from: actions, to: main-board/market, count: 5, face: up }
  - place: worker
    at: [-270, 240]
  - place: score-marker.red
    at: main-board/score-track/0
  - place: score-marker.green
    at: main-board/score-track/0
  - place: coins
    at: main-board/supply
  - place: d6
    at: main-board/supply
```
